y.Geographic & Channel Reach: Presence across Indian states and distribution partnerships. Evidence includes number of offices, resellers, and service coverage in rural and urban areas.
y.Partnerships & Ecosystem: Strategic alliances with tech firms, research institutions, and integrators. Evidence includes named partners, joint ventures, and consortium memberships.
